expected_visible: Collect 3 energy cells, then reach EXIT.
3つのエネルギーを集めて出口に到達しよう。
矢印 / WASD / 隣のマスをクリック
Out of moves. Press R to retry.
手数がなくなりました。Rで再挑戦。

steps.instruction: Do not explain rules. Start a 30-second stopwatch at first visible frame; tester independently says goal, controls and retry. Record exact spoken answer and time per answer.
steps.pass_if: Tester identifies 3 cells then EXIT, movement by arrows/WASD or adjacent click, and R restart within 30 seconds WITHOUT prompting.
steps.fail_if: Any goal/control/retry omitted, misunderstood, prompted or learned only after 30 seconds.

steps.instruction: Review English initial screenshot AND the real executable, including subtitle, counters, message and five buttons.
steps.pass_if: Every required English phrase is fully legible, no glyph truncation, and all buttons are clickable.
steps.fail_if: Ellipsis, missing glyph, clipped button, overlap, invisible control or unreadable font.

steps.instruction: Press J; review Japanese initial screenshot AND real executable. Confirm JP translation and persistent language while moving.
steps.pass_if: All required Japanese text is fully readable, goal/control/retry correctly conveyed and title is Signal Sprint | JP.
steps.fail_if: Untranslated critical instruction, tofu/missing glyph, overflow, truncated counter or language resets on movement.

steps.instruction: Measure physical 1024x768 monitor, Windows taskbar work area and game window rectangle; capture uncropped monitor screenshot.
steps.pass_if: Actual window and all visible information/buttons fit within actual work area, not merely full monitor.
steps.fail_if: Any control/text outside work area or covered by taskbar; no real rectangle/screenshot evidence.

steps.instruction: In EN make 30 legal RIGHT/LEFT moves, observe LOST, press R, make one RIGHT move.
steps.pass_if: LOST + 0 moves is legible, R returns to 30 moves, replay shows 29 and responds.
steps.fail_if: Crash, freeze, no LOST, no R reset, misleading status, no replay or clipped text.

steps.instruction: Repeat 30 legal moves in JP on the SAME EXE; verify 失敗, R reset, next move.
steps.pass_if: 失敗 + 残り手数0 legible; R restores 30, next move 29; no JP clipping.
steps.fail_if: Missing Japanese state text, R failure, language drift or unresponsive controls.

steps.instruction: Explicitly check blocked move does not falsely decrement, focus loss/no input is not marked success, and intentionally wrong EXE/SHA or clipped screenshots are rejected by evidence gate.
steps.pass_if: All negative outcomes recorded with actual observation or test reference; no synthetic screenshot is called human PASS.
steps.fail_if: Any negative case untested or reported PASS without evidence.

steps.instruction: Ask first-time tester without coaching: Was goal clear? Would you voluntarily play another round, and why? Record verbatim reason.
steps.pass_if: Unprompted comprehension and an actual reason to replay are documented; this is qualitative only.
steps.fail_if: No independent tester, only developer judgement, or no reason to replay.

notes: Reference screenshot geometry and pixel ROI are CHECK_ONLY, not proof of text semantics. The pinned GUI evidence artifact uploads evidence/ only, not the EXE. Obtain a byte-identical EXE and verify SHA before physical QA. Never promote review EXE to GDK package EXE. Human test must use an independent first-time tester; record HOLD if unavailable.
